newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Qingling raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Qingling raised to buy.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it upgraded its intermediate rating on Qingling Motors Ltd to buy from accumulate following the company's interim results and raised its 1996 and 1997 net profit forecasts.
In a report dated September 4, Merrill said it revised its 1996 net profit to 450 million yuan from 420 million and its 1997 net profit forecast to 590 million yuan from 540 million.
Last month Qingling reported first-half 1996 net profit of 183.01 million yuan versus 29.65 million a year earlier.

Merrill said a 33 percent rise in first-half unit sales "largely exceeded" its full-year estimates and it had raised its 1996 unit sales projection to 37,500 vehicles from a previous estimate of 35,000 and its 1997 estimate to 45,000 from 40,000.
It said China's auto industry was set to recover next year, aided by China's recent interest rate cut and stronger Gross Domestic Product growth in coming years.

"The stock still trades at the low end of its long term prospective PE multiple, suggesting still considerable further upside potential likely to be driven by the forecast earnings growth," Merrill said.
